留空使用目标主机名: Leave blank to use target hostname

仅加密至目标的连接；目标服务必须支持 TLS。发送 Proxy 头时，头部也在: Only connections to the target are encrypted; the target service must support TLS. When sending the Proxy header, the header is also transmitted within TLS.

Please enter the remote address. Multiple addresses are separated by newlines. For example: 192.168.1.100:8080 example.com:3000
